notes: New Product Image Studio: turn one product photo into nine marketplace-ready images.
Move, scale and rotate the cut-out product, text, logo and stickers freely on every image.
Text supports multiple fonts, bold, colour, outline, gradient, glow, shadow and vertical writing.
Automatic background removal with erase and restore brushes for clean edges.
Complete built-in background library: solid colours, clean surfaces, premium display stages and holiday templates.
One-tap export of all nine images to the local gallery.
